sources.title: Microsoft Copilot
sources.snippet: Microsoft Copilot is AI built to help you get things done. Create, brainstorm, learn, and solve problems with AI chat that works across your day.

sources.title: LimX Dynamics | Official Website
sources.snippet: LimX Dynamics is an embodied AI robotics company focused on developing innovative products around three core technologies: original robot hardware design and manufacturing, brain-cerebellum fusion technology, and the humanoid brain system COSA, advancing AGI from the digital world into the physical world.
